knowledge:
- key_parameters: gr=A GRanges object containing breakend-centric structural variant calls, typically generated via StructuralVariantAnnotation::breakpointRanges ;; numtS=A GRanges object containing known NUMT regions ;; genomeMT=A DNAString or similar sequence object representing the mitochondrial genome sequence ;; max_ins_dist=Maximum insertion distance allowed when identifying NUMT events (e.g., 20)
- alternatives: None mentioned for NUMT detection; uses VariantAnnotation for VCF parsing, StructuralVariantAnnotation for breakend conversion, and circlize for visualization
- when_to_use: When you have structural variant calls (specifically in breakend/BND notation, such as those from GRIDSS) and want to identify nuclear-mitochondrial insertion (NUMT) events
- pitfalls: StructuralVariantAnnotation requires the input GRanges object to be composed entirely of valid breakpoints, so users must ensure breakpoint consistency before running numtDetect ;; The sequence levels style of the known NUMT regions (numtS) and the input GRanges must be compatible (e.g., using seqlevelsStyle)

workflows.name: detect_and_visualize_numts
workflows.intent: Detect nuclear-mitochondrial DNA fusion (NUMT) events from structural variant calls and visualize them using circos plots.
input: vcf_file.vcf (Structural variant calls in VCF format, e.g., from GRIDSS)
BSgenome (A BSgenome object containing the reference genome and mitochondrial sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Load structural variant calls from VCF and convert to breakend-centric GRanges ;; 2. Load and format known NUMT regions ;; 3. Extract the mitochondrial genome sequence ;; 4. Detect NUMT events using numtDetect ;; 5. Subset or filter detected NUMTs by genomic region ;; 6. Convert breakends to pairs and visualize using circlize circos plots
workflows.code:
library(StructuralVariantAnnotation)
library(VariantAnnotation)
library(svaNUMT)

vcf <- readVcf(system.file("extdata", "chr1_numt_pe_HS25.sv.vcf", package = "svaNUMT"))
gr <- breakpointRanges(vcf)

library(readr)
numtS <- read_table(system.file("extdata", "numtS.txt", package = "svaNUMT"), 
    col_names = FALSE)
colnames(numtS) <- c("bin", "seqnames", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand")
numtS <- GRanges(numtS)
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(numtS) <- "NCBI"

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19
genomeMT <- genome$chrMT

NUMT <- numtDetect(gr, numtS, genomeMT, max_ins_dist = 20)

GRangesList(NU=NUMT$MT$NU$`1`[[1]], MT=NUMT$MT$MT$`1`[[1]])

seqnames = 1
start = 1000000
end = 3000000
i <- sapply(NUMT$MT$NU[[seqnames]], function(x) 
  sum(countOverlaps(x, GRanges(seqnames = seqnames, IRanges(start, end))))>0)
list(NU=NUMT$MT$NU[[seqnames]][i], MT=NUMT$MT$MT[[seqnames]][i])

library(circlize)
numt_chr_prefix <- c(NUMT$MT$NU$`1`[[2]], NUMT$MT$MT$`1`[[2]])
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(numt_chr_prefix) <- "UCSC"
pairs <- breakpointgr2pairs(numt_chr_prefix)
pairs

circos.initializeWithIdeogram(
    data.frame(V1=c("chr1", "chrM"),
               V2=c(1791073,1),
               V3=c(1791093,16571),
               V4=c("p15.4",NA),
               V5=c("gpos50",NA)),  sector.width = c(0.2, 0.8))
#circos.initializeWithIdeogram()
circos.genomicLink(as.data.frame(S4Vectors::first(pairs)), 
                   as.data.frame(S4Vectors::second(pairs)))
circos.clear()
